name: toolbar
source: grid toolbar · _base-bulk-action-bar · widget-title (the Toolbars family, minus the page/app headers)
summary: The control strip that frames a LIST/TABLE or a widget. Three compositions via `variant`: grid (default) — a strip ABOVE a grid with search (start slot) on the left and filter / column-chooser / primary Add (default slot) on the right; bulk — the floating SELECTION pill (a clear checkbox + "N items selected" + a divider + the bulk actions), shown once rows are selected, emits `clear`; widget — a widget header (title + a time-range pill + a kebab of actions) with rounded-top chrome. NOT the page title bar (obs-page-header) and NOT the global top bar (obs-app-header). Compose the contents from DS elements (obs-input, obs-button, obs-checkbox, obs-icon, obs-select).

variants.name: grid
variants.what: strip above a grid: search (left) + a filter button + the WORKING column chooser (eye = obs-select column mode) + a primary Add (right)

variants.name: bulk
variants.what: floating selection pill: checkbox + N-selected + primary/danger actions

variants.name: widget
variants.what: widget header: title + time-range pill + kebab

variants.name: bulk-single
variants.what: bulk bar with count=1 renders "1 item selected" (singular)

variant.note: grid (default) · bulk (floating selection pill) · widget (widget header chrome).

count.note: (bulk) the number of selected rows → renders a checkbox + "N items selected" + a divider before the actions. Clearing the checkbox fires `clear`.

title.note: (widget) the widget title on the left (14px, weight 500, ellipsised).

events.clear: () — (bulk) the selection checkbox was cleared (wire it to reset your row selection).

slots.start: (grid) the left-side content — typically the search field (obs-input type=search).
slots.default: the main content on the right (grid: filter/column/Add) · (bulk) the bulk action buttons · (widget) the time-range pill + kebab.

decisionFlow: A search / filter / column / Add strip ABOVE a list or table? -> obs-toolbar (variant=grid, the default).
A floating bar that appears once rows are SELECTED (N selected + Acknowledge / Assign / Delete)? -> obs-toolbar variant=bulk.
A widget's own header (title + time-range + a kebab of widget actions)? -> obs-toolbar variant=widget.
The page's title + primary actions (not tied to a list)? -> obs-page-header, NOT toolbar.
The global app top bar (logo / notifications / user)? -> obs-app-header.
The column show/hide dropdown itself? -> the Dropdown (obs-select) column-chooser mode, composed behind the column button.

grid.useWhen: any list/table page needs search + filters + column show/hide + a primary Add above the grid.
grid.dontUse: for the page title bar -> obs-page-header.
grid.example: search (left) + filter + the column chooser (eye = obs-select column mode: show/hide + drag-reorder columns) + Add Monitor (right), above the Monitors grid.

bulk.useWhen: the user has selected rows and needs to act on the selection.
bulk.dontUse: as a permanent toolbar (it appears only while rows are selected).
bulk.example: "3 items selected" + Acknowledge · Assign · Delete (danger) · More.

widget.useWhen: a dashboard widget/card needs its own header (title + window + actions).
widget.dontUse: for a page or list header.
widget.example: "CPU Utilization" + a 24h time pill + a ⋮ of Edit / Clone / Full Screen / Share / Export.

bulk-single.useWhen: the bulk selection bar with exactly ONE row selected — it reads “1 item selected” (singular)
bulk-single.dontUse: nothing selected (hide the bar) or >1 (plural “N items selected”)

do: Use variant=grid for the search/filter/column/Add strip above a list or table.
Use variant=bulk for the floating selection bar (checkbox + count + primary/danger actions); wire `clear` to reset selection.
Use variant=widget for a dashboard widget header (title + time-range pill + kebab).
Compose the contents from DS elements — obs-input (search), obs-button (Add / bulk actions), obs-checkbox, obs-icon, obs-select/obs-menu (filter/column popovers).
dont: Don’t use for a page title bar (title + page actions) — that is obs-page-header.
Don’t use for the global app top bar (logo / notifications / user) — that is obs-app-header.
Don’t hand-build the search box or action buttons — reuse obs-input / obs-button.
Don’t keep the bulk bar visible when nothing is selected — render it only while count > 0.

a11y.summary: The bulk bar is a role=toolbar with an aria-label ("Bulk actions"); the clear checkbox is a real obs-checkbox (keyboard-operable, fires `clear`); the count is plain text ("N items selected"). Grid/widget toolbars are plain strips — their contents (obs-input/obs-button) carry their own semantics. The divider is decorative (aria-hidden).

issues.issue: In the bulk bar, announce the selection change to assistive tech (an aria-live region on "N items selected") so screen-reader users hear the count update as rows are (de)selected.

knownIssues.issue: obs-toolbar renders the strip/pill/header CHROME + the selection affordances; the filter and column-chooser POPOVERS are composed behind the buttons (obs-select / obs-menu) — the grid-toolbar story shows them as icon buttons. The column chooser (eye button) is itself a checkbox dropdown (obs-select), not part of the toolbar.

changelog.change: Consolidated: the grid toolbar now embeds the WORKING column chooser (the eye button IS obs-select in column mode) instead of a dead icon button — "Column chooser" was never a separate toolbar variant, only the grid strip with a functional column control, so the duplicate preset/gallery example and the phantom column-chooser variant were removed. The grid toolbar is the single source; the column chooser is its column control.

Completeness pass: `variant` now declares its enum (grid/bulk/widget); the column-chooser is folded into the Dropdown — the eye button composes obs-select in column-chooser mode (reusing its popover positioning) and its icon button matches the sibling filter (35x35, --default-button-text) for size + colour parity; the widget-header playground now renders a chart body so the top chrome reads as a complete card. Playground presets reach every variant (grid, bulk, single-select, widget, column-chooser).

Matched the bulk action bar to the REAL product (_base-bulk-action-bar.vue): BORDERED action buttons (obs-button default) + red-bordered danger + a ⋮ More menu, muted --neutral-light count text, real padding/shadow (story was a simplified reproduction — 12 intentional deltas). Widget kebab is now a WORKING obs-menu (Edit/Clone/Full Screen/Share/Export). Added the Column chooser variant (eye → obs-select of column checkboxes). Playground is Preset-driven (variant + content switch together) so selecting Widget no longer shows grid content.

Added obs-toolbar element — the list/table control strip: grid (search + filter/column/Add), bulk (floating N-selected pill + primary/danger actions, emits `clear`), and widget (title + time-range pill + kebab) variants, split from the product Toolbars family. diff.mjs ✅ MATCH (light+dark); reuses obs-checkbox/obs-icon and composes obs-input/obs-button. 4th of the Structure & Navigation set.
